name: Puzzles
subtopics: Month & Date Puzzle (2 dates x 4 months)
concept: Puzzles test your ability to synthesize constraints, cross-reference multiple attributes (persons, dates, floors, colors), and eliminate contradictory cases systematically.
concept_hi: पहेलियाँ विभिन्न बाधाओं को संयोजित करने, कई विशेषताओं (व्यक्ति, मंजिल, तिथियाँ) को परस्पर जोड़ने और असंभव स्थितियों को छांटने की क्षमता की जांच करती हैं।
eight_step_framework: 1. Identify Puzzle Type & grid dimensions immediately.
2. Draw the skeletal framework (floors top-to-bottom, months chronologically).
3. Isolate the 'Anchor Clue' (definite position or fixed pair).
4. Branch into maximum 2 or 3 active parallel cases.
5. Plot relative distance/gap clues (e.g., 'Three persons between P and Q').
6. Check negative conditions ('P does not like Red') to prune dead branches.
7. Verify all remaining attributes against unused constraints.
8. Rapidly answer the 5 sub-questions without recalculating.
common_traps: Starting with a weak clue like 'A is an immediate neighbor of someone who likes Red'.
Misinterpreting 'Three floors between A and B' as 4th floor above instead of counting intermediate gaps.
Confusing 'even numbered floor' with 'even numbered flat'.
Failing to note base year in age calculation puzzles (e.g., age as on 2024).
shortcut_method: Parallel Case Elimination: Draw Case 1 and Case 2 side-by-side on your rough sheet with shared fixed columns. Discard the invalid case as soon as a single contradiction arises.
mental_trick: Look for the most repeated character in clues; that character connects disjointed statements into a continuous chain.

name: Seating Arrangement
concept: Arranging entities around defined geometric borders (line, circle, polygon) subject to positional relations (left/right, opposite, between, neighbors).
concept_hi: ज्यामितीय सीमाओं (पंक्ति, वृत्त, वर्ग) के चारों ओर व्यक्तियों को उनके दाएँ/बाएँ और सम्मुख संबंधों के अनुसार व्यवस्थित करना।
common_traps: Inverting left and right when facing South or facing Outside.
Assuming 'opposite' in an odd-numbered table (opposite exists only in even-numbered symmetric tables).
Treating 'immediate right' the same as '3rd to the right'.
shortcut_method: Circle Right-Hand Rule: When facing centre, Right = Anti-Clockwise, Left = Clockwise. When facing outside, invert: Right = Clockwise, Left = Anti-Clockwise.
mental_trick: In linear parallel rows, solve the row with more definite clues first, then map the facing counterparts.

name: Syllogism
subtopics: Standard Quantifiers (All, No, Some, Some Not)
'Only A are B' (All B are A & Exclusive to A)
concept: Deductive logic evaluating whether given conclusions definitively follow from hypothetical premises without assuming real-world facts.
concept_hi: कथनों के आधार पर निष्कर्षों की सत्यता और संभावना की तार्किक जांच।
common_traps: Confusing 'Only a few A are B' (means both: Some A are B AND Some A are NOT B).
Forgetting that in 'Only A are B', B cannot have any relation with any other element except A!
Marking 'Either-Or' for 'All A are B' + 'No A is B' (This is NOT a valid complementary pair! Valid pairs: Some + No, Some + Some Not).
shortcut_method: The 10-Second Negative Check: If all statements are affirmative (All/Some), no definite negative conclusion (No/Some not) can ever be true!
mental_trick: Possibility Rule: If there is no cross (restriction) between two circles, any possibility between them is ALWAYS TRUE.

name: Inequality
subtopics: Either-Or Cases (> and = for ≥, or opposite sign trichotomy)
concept: Evaluating algebraic comparison relations between variables along directed order chains.
concept_hi: चरों के बीच बड़े, छोटे और बराबर के संबंधों का परीक्षण करना।
common_traps: Opposite Signs Trap: If you encounter opposite signs (e.g. > and <) anywhere between two elements in a chain, no direct relation can be established!
Forgetting Either-Or when conclusion is A > B and A = B while the chain gives A ≥ B.
shortcut_method: Door / Open Gate Method: Treat '>' as an open door from left to right. You can travel from A to B if doors stay open in that direction. Priority: '>' > '≥' > '='.
mental_trick: For 'A > B' to hold, the path from A to B must have only open gates AND at least one strict '>' gate.

name: Coding-Decoding
subtopics: Letter to Letter / Number Shifts (+1, -2, reverse)
New Pattern Mains Coding (Logic on word length, vowels, consonants)
concept: Deciphering systematic encryption rules applied to words, letters, numbers, or symbols.
concept_hi: शब्दों और अक्षरों के कूटबद्ध स्वरूप में छिपे नियमों को पहचानना।
common_traps: Writing down all 4 sentences in Chinese coding on rough sheet (waste of 45 seconds). Compare directly on screen by looking at the specific questioned word!
Missing composite logic in Mains (e.g., Symbol = count of vowels, Letter = opposite of second letter).
shortcut_method: Target-Only Elimination: Read only the word asked in the question. Find which sentences it appears in. If unique to that sentence, pick the unique code immediately.
mental_trick: Opposite letters always sum to 27! (A=1 + Z=26 = 27; G=7 + T=20 = 27).

name: Blood Relations
subtopics: Coded Blood Relations (P + Q means P is father of Q)
concept: Tracing genealogical relationships across generations using unambiguous familial labels.
concept_hi: पारिवारिक पीढ़ियों और संबंधों का सटीक विश्लेषण।
common_traps: Assuming gender based on name (e.g., assuming 'Kiran' or 'Sunita' is female without an explicit gender clue).
Confusing 'Maternal Uncle' (Mother's brother) with 'Paternal Uncle' (Father's brother).
shortcut_method: Generation Numbering & Gender Filter: Assign +1 for father/mother, 0 for brother/sister/spouse, -1 for son/daughter. If question asks 'How is A related to B', first eliminate options whose gender does not match A.
mental_trick: Double line '=' for married couple, single horizontal line '-' for siblings, vertical line '|' for parent-child.

name: Direction & Distance
subtopics: Cardinal & Intercardinal Points (N, S, E, W, NE, NW, SE, SW)
Coded Direction (A # B (5m) means A is north of B)
concept: Navigating spatial coordinates and vector displacement from origin to destination.
concept_hi: मूल बिंदु से सापेक्ष दिशा और विस्थापन की गणना।
common_traps: Confusing 'Point A is 5m North of B' with 'Point B is 5m North of A'. Always identify who is the reference point!
Forgetting sunrise shadow falls to the West; sunset shadow falls to the East.
shortcut_method: Coordinate Cartesian Shortcut: North = +Y, South = -Y, East = +X, West = -X. Sum all X movements and Y movements. Shortest distance = √(X² + Y²).
mental_trick: Facing North: Right=East. Facing South: Right=West. Facing East: Right=South. Facing West: Right=North.

name: Ranking & Order
concept: Positional arithmetic within a discrete sequential array of items.
concept_hi: पंक्ति में व्यक्तियों के स्थानों और कुल संख्या की गणना।
common_traps: Forgetting to subtract 1 when summing top and bottom ranks for the same person.
In overlapping cases, Total = (Left + Right) - (Persons in between + 2).
shortcut_method: Golden Formula: Total = (Rank from Left + Rank from Right) - 1. When positions interchange: New Total = (Person 1 new rank + Person 2 old rank) - 1.
mental_trick: If sum of ranks > Total, it is an overlapping case! Gaps = (Rank 1 + Rank 2) - Total - 2.

name: Alphanumeric Series
prelims_weightage: 4-5 Questions (Huge scoring topic in Clerk Prelims)
subtopics: Left/Right Relative Positions (mth from left of nth from right)
Preceded By & Succeeded By / Followed By
concept: Sequential indexing, pattern filtration, and directional hopping along a mixed symbol stream.
concept_hi: अक्षरों, संख्याओं और प्रतीकों की श्रृंखला में स्थिति आधारित प्रश्नों को हल करना।
common_traps: Confusing 'Preceded by' (comes BEFORE) with 'Followed by' (comes AFTER).
Counting manually from the wrong end.
shortcut_method: Direction Cancellation: Same directions subtract, Opposite directions add! E.g., '5th to the right of 15th from right' = (15 - 5) = 10th from right!
mental_trick: P-B-F mnemonic: Preceded = Before, Followed = Forward (After).

name: Number & Letter Series
concept: Arithmetic and positional progressions over letter positions and digits.
concept_hi: अक्षरों और अंकों के बदलाव और गणितीय अनुक्रम।
common_traps: Operating on digits without reading whether changes must be ascending or descending.
shortcut_method: Check only the first or last digit/letter if the question asks for highest/lowest value instead of rewriting the entire set of numbers.
mental_trick: Alphabet wrap-around: Z + 1 = A, A - 1 = Z.

name: Input-Output (Machine Input)
prelims_weightage: 0-1 Set (Rare in Prelims, frequent in SBI/IBPS Mains)
concept: Algorithm step analysis where an initial sequence undergoes deterministic reordering until final state.
concept_hi: मशीन द्वारा इनपुट को चरणों में व्यवस्थित करने के नियमों को समझना।
common_traps: Writing out all steps completely when you only need to determine which step a specific word occupies.
Overlooking auto-arranged elements: If an element is already in its required position, it does not consume an extra step!
shortcut_method: Short-Notation Indexing: Label target positions (L1, R1, L2, R2...) above each word in the input row. Find auto-placements without writing 6 intermediate rows.
mental_trick: Check Step 1 and the Final Step first to instantly identify the overarching sorting rule (words vs numbers).

name: Data Sufficiency
concept: Determining whether given factual statements are logically adequate to compute a singular definitive answer.
concept_hi: यह तय करना कि दिए गए कथन प्रश्न का अद्वितीय उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं या नहीं।
common_traps: Actually computing the full numerical/seat answer! You only need to know IF a single unique answer exists, not what the answer is.
Assuming Statement 2 fails just because Statement 1 worked. Always evaluate Statement 2 independently before combining!
shortcut_method: The 3-Step Independence Protocol: 1) Test Statement I alone. 2) Test Statement II alone. 3) Only if neither alone is sufficient, combine I + II.
mental_trick: If Statement I gives two possible answers, it is INSUFFICIENT. Sufficiency demands exactly ONE unique solution.

name: Critical / Logical Reasoning
concept: Evaluating verbal arguments, identifying unstated premises, practical remedies, and causal links in real-world governance scenarios.
concept_hi: कथन और पूर्वधारणा, निष्कर्ष, कार्यवाही और कारण-प्रभाव का वस्तुनिष्ठ विश्लेषण।
common_traps: Bringing outside general knowledge into Statement & Assumption.
Selecting an extreme Course of Action (e.g., 'immediately sack all employees' - excessive, non-viable).
Confusing correlation with causation in Cause & Effect.
shortcut_method: Negation Technique for Assumptions: If you negate the assumption and the author's primary argument collapses, then that assumption is 100% VALID.
mental_trick: Good Course of Action must be: Feasible, Proportional, and directly address the root problem without creating worse side effects.

name: Statement & Conclusion
concept: Deducing what undeniably follows from the statement without exaggeration.
concept_hi: कथन से सीधे और अचूक रूप से निकलने वाले निष्कर्ष।
common_traps: Assuming possibilities as definite truths.
Words like 'only', 'all', 'never' often indicate invalid extreme conclusions.
shortcut_method: Extreme Word Filter: Words like definitely, always, never, only usually fail unless explicitly supported.
mental_trick: If you have to think 'maybe this could happen', it is NOT a conclusion.

name: Statement & Assumption
concept: Identifying what the speaker took for granted prior to uttering the statement.
concept_hi: कथन कहने से पहले वक्ता द्वारा मान ली गई बातें।
common_traps: Treating an assumption as an outcome rather than a premise.
shortcut_method: Notice / Advertisement Rule: Notices and advertisements ALWAYS assume people will read and respond favorably.
mental_trick: Assumption comes BEFORE the statement; conclusion comes AFTER.

name: Cause & Effect
concept: Analyzing chronological and causal relationships between two independent events.
concept_hi: दो घटनाओं के बीच कारण और उसके परिणाम का संबंध।
common_traps: Assuming event A caused event B just because A happened first (Post hoc fallacy).
shortcut_method: The 'BECAUSE' Test: Insert 'Because Statement A happened, therefore Statement B occurred'. If natural and logical, A is cause and B is effect.
mental_trick: Look for shared common underlying catalysts (e.g. heavy monsoon rain affecting both transport and vegetable prices).

name: Course of Action
concept: Formulating constructive, practical, and non-vindictive administrative steps to alleviate a problem.
concept_hi: समस्या के निवारण के लिए व्यावहारिक और संतुलित प्रशासनिक कदम।
common_traps: Selecting harsh punishment over constructive preventive action.
shortcut_method: Proportionality & Feasibility Check: Is the action realistic? Does it solve the problem directly? If yes, it is valid.
mental_trick: The action should not generate a bigger problem than the one it solves.

name: Coded Inequality
concept: Inequality where mathematical operators are disguised as symbols (@, #, $, %, ©).
concept_hi: चिह्नों के रूप में प्रस्तुत असमानता के संबंध।
common_traps: Re-substituting symbols one by one for every conclusion (wastes time).
shortcut_method: The Magic Box Technique: Place > at top-left, ≥ at middle-left, < at top-right, ≤ at middle-right, and = at centre. Trace diagonal and vertical paths visually.
mental_trick: Horizontal crossover in Magic Box means opposite signs -> direct conclusion impossible!

name: Coded Blood Relation
subtopics: Forward Coding (A+B means A is mother of B)
Backward Coding (A+B means B is mother of A)
concept: Familial relations encoded using mathematical and typographical operators.
concept_hi: चिह्नों और प्रतीकों द्वारा कूटबद्ध किए गए पारिवारिक रिश्ते।
common_traps: Ignoring backward coding clues! If A*B means 'B is son of A', reading from left to right causes reverse gender errors.
shortcut_method: Gender and Generation Pruning: Sum the generation integers of operators between the two target individuals. Match against expected generational gap.
mental_trick: Eliminate options where the target person's gender cannot be determined (often the last person in a forward-coded string).

name: Coded Direction
subtopics: Distance modifier brackets: A#B (12) means A is 10m North of B (-2 rule)
concept: Direction and distance expressions governed by symbolic notation and arithmetic offset brackets.
concept_hi: प्रतीकों और दूरी समीकरणों पर आधारित दिशा परीक्षण।
common_traps: Missing the distance bracket modifier rule (e.g. Bracket value + 3 or - 2).
shortcut_method: Decode the direction symbols first, write actual distances next to each link, then sketch standard 2D vector path.
mental_trick: Translate all statements onto a single rough coordinate grid rather than drawing disconnected segments.

name: Miscellaneous Reasoning
subtopics: Pair of Letters in Words (both forward & backward alphabetical distance)
Meaningful Word Formation from specified letter indices
Number Digits Reordering (odd add 1, even subtract 1)
concept: High-speed isolated single-mark questions testing attention to detail and lexical rules.
concept_hi: शब्दों में अक्षरों के युग्म, अर्थपूर्ण शब्द निर्माण और संख्या रूपांतरण।
common_traps: Missing the backward count in 'how many pairs of letters have the same number of letters between them as in the English alphabet'.
Meaningful word trap: If you are not 100% sure about English vocabulary, SKIP meaningful word questions! They are known negative-mark traps.
shortcut_method: Alphabet Number Mapping for Letter Pairs: Convert word letters to their numerical positions (e.g. B-A-N-K -> 2, 1, 14, 11). Counting numbers sequentially is 3x faster than chanting alphabet letters.
mental_trick: If a question asks to form a word and answers include 'If more than one word can be formed mark X, if none mark Y', treat it with extreme care.
